blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Ground-based planetary imaging suffers from atmospheric turbulence, sensor noise, and limited sampling, making restoration a joint denoising, deblurring, and super-resolution problem. We present ASTRA-SR, a blind single-frame restoration framework trained on a physics-grounded synthetic dataset. High-dynamic-range spacecraft RAW observations serve as clean sources, and paired LR inputs are synthesized using measured layer-integrated turbulence strengths, propagated moving phase screens, exposure-averaged spatially varying PSFs, and sensor noise. ASTRA-SR first estimates a noise-suppressed but blur-retaining LR image, then restores spatial structure through multiscale processing and reconstructs HR detail with serial spatial-amplitude refinement. It yields a 0.49 dB foreground PSNR gain over the strongest baseline approaches.
blocks.zh: 地上行星成像受到大气扰动、传感器噪音和有限采样的影响,使恢复成为联合去诺、去污和超解问题。 我们介绍ASTRA-SR,一个盲目的单帧修复框架,训练有素的物理合成数据集. 高动能-射程航天器RAW观测作为清洁来源,对成对的LR输入利用所测量的地层综合扰动强度进行合成,传播相相屏,曝光平均空间变化的PSF和传感器噪声. ASTRA-SR首先估计出一个被噪声压制但被模糊保留了的LR图像,然后通过多尺度的处理来恢复空间结构,并用序列空间样本的完善来重建HR细节. 它比最强基线方法得到0.49分贝的预测PSNR收益。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Planetary imaging reveals atmospheric bands, storms, rings, impact structures, and surface morphology, supporting scientific monitoring and coordinated professional–amateur observations [ 29 , 13 ] . Professional observatories and space missions provide high-quality measurements, but access to major facilities is scarce and cannot support routine individual use. Affordable telescopes and cameras are more accessible, although their images contain substantially less detail than spaceborne or large-observatory data. Reliable enhancement of a single observation is therefore valuable when adaptive optics, repeated lucky-imaging acquisition, or extensive multi-frame processing is unavailable.
blocks.zh: 行星成像揭示出大气带,风暴,环,撞击结构,和地表形态,支持科学监测和协调的专业业余观测[29,13]. 专业观测站和空间飞行任务提供高质量的测量,但进入主要设施的机会很少,无法支持日常的个人使用。 价格低廉的望远镜和相机更容易取用,尽管其图像中包含的细节远远少于由太空或大型观测数据. 因此,在没有适应光学、反复获得幸运图或大量多帧处理的情况下,可靠地加强单一观测是有价值的。

blocks.zh: 图1:ASTRA-SR建筑. 合成道产生已退化的LR输入和只受训练的目标;恢复道包含三相阶的SCGN主干道,中间LR估计分支,相位特异性改进,相继的空间-拓扑HR头.

blocks.en: Ground-based planetary images are degraded by turbulence-induced local displacement, spatially varying blur, contrast attenuation, and temporal intensity variation. Finite exposure averages these effects into an effective point-spread function (PSF), while detector noise and limited sampling cause further information loss. Consequently, planetary bands become oversmoothed and ring edges or crater boundaries become indistinct. Recovering a high-resolution (HR) image from one low-resolution (LR) observation therefore couples denoising, deblurring, and super-resolution while risking noise amplification and artifacts [ 33 , 26 , 34 ] .

blocks.en: Learning-based natural-image restoration benefits from large collections of aligned clean targets and degraded inputs [ 4 , 40 ] . Comparable astronomical pairs are rarely available because the same celestial scene cannot be captured under identical turbulent and turbulence-free conditions. Existing datasets therefore either pair observations from different instruments or synthesize turbulence from clean images. Cross-instrument pairs remain affected by differences in pixel scale, spectral response, optical PSF, detector noise, exposure, acquisition time, and viewing geometry after registration. Synthetic approaches scale more readily, but rendered RGB imagery and generic turbulence models may not represent high-dynamic-range spacecraft RAW data, measured layered turbulence, finite-exposure averaging, and instrument-specific sensor noise.
blocks.zh: 基于学习的自然图像恢复受益于大量收集的一致清洁目标和退化的投入[4,40]。 由于在同一动荡和无动荡条件下无法捕捉到同样的天体,因此很少有可比较的天文对. 因此,现有的数据集要么从不同的仪器中进行对接观测,要么从干净的图像中合成出动荡. 相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相相相接相接相接相接相接相接相相接相接相 合成方法的尺度更方便,但使RGB图像和通用扰动模型可能不代表高动力-距离航天器RAW数据、所测地层扰动、有限接触平均和仪器专用传感器噪声。

blocks.en: ASTRA-SR addresses this gap with a physics-grounded planetary RAW dataset and a blind single-frame restoration framework. Spacecraft observations provide high-dynamic-range, turbulence-free clean sources; measured layer-integrated turbulence strengths, propagated moving phase screens, exposure-averaged spatially varying PSFs, and sensor noise produce paired LR inputs. The network first estimates a noise-suppressed but blur-retaining LR image, then restores spatial structure through blur-aware multiscale processing, and finally reconstructs HR detail through serial spatial-amplitude refinement. Our contributions are (i) a planetary dataset of spacecraft RAW images and physically simulated LR pairs, (ii) a staged spatial-frequency framework for denoising and deblurring, and (iii) a serial spatial-amplitude HR head.
blocks.zh: ASTRA-SR用一个以物理为底的行星RAW数据集和一个盲的单帧还原框架来弥补这一缺口. 航天器观测提供了高能动、无相流的清洁源;测得的地层综合相流强度;传播相相屏;曝光平均空间变化的PSF;传感器噪声产生成对的LR输入。 网络首先估计出一个噪声被压制但保留了模糊的LR图像,然后通过模糊的认知多尺度处理恢复了空间结构,最后通过串行的空间-放大改进重建了HR细节. 我们的贡献是:(一) 航天器RAW图像的行星数据集和物理模拟的LR对,(二) 用于去色和去色的相位空间频率框架,以及(三) 连续空间-模拟HR头。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: General image restoration uses convolutional priors [ 4 ] , Transformer and frequency-domain modeling [ 40 , 15 ] , state-space architectures [ 11 , 10 ] , and diffusion priors [ 39 , 20 , 36 ] . Recent work also explores data-centric training, self-ensemble, complementary branch fusion, and efficient super-resolution [ 2 , 3 , 9 , 31 ] . Explicit inverse formulations include plug-and-play restoration [ 42 ] , blind deconvolution [ 32 , 5 ] , and distribution matching [ 28 ] .
blocks.zh: 一般图像还原使用回转前缀 [4],变形器和频率域模型 [40,15],状态-空间架构 [11,10],并传播前传 [39,20,36]. 最近的工作还探索了以数据为中心的训练,自相交流,互补的分支聚变,以及高效的超解[2,3,9,31]. 明确反向配方包括插值和游戏还原[42],盲解分解[32,5],并配给[28].

blocks.en: Astronomical restoration additionally depends on atmospheric propagation and instrument-specific acquisition. P2S accelerates turbulence synthesis [ 27 ] ; PlaNet combines synthetic planetary turbulence with variable-frame restoration [ 37 ] ; FluxFlow uses co-registered ground-to-space pairs [ 23 ] ; and recent methods model adaptive-optics super-resolution or video turbulence [ 34 , 43 ] . Sensor-aware RAW processing, physical-degradation benchmarks, and noise modeling [ 22 , 21 , 1 , 24 ] complement self-supervised scientific denoising [ 17 , 19 , 25 , 12 ] . ASTRA-SR focuses on blind single-frame planetary RAW restoration under spatially varying, exposure-averaged turbulence and sensor noise.
blocks.zh: 恢复天文还取决于大气传播和特定仪器的获取。 P2S加速了扰动合成[27];PlaNet将合成行星扰动与可变帧还原[37];FluxFlow使用共同注册的地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地对地 感知RAW处理,物理降解基准,噪声模型[22,21,1,24]补充了自我监督的科学去诺[17,19,25,12]. blocks.en: 3.2 Planetary RAW Dataset and LR Observation Formation
blocks.zh: 3.2 行星RAW 数据集和LR观测形成

blocks.en: We collect approximately 400,000 raw observations from the Cassini Imaging Science Subsystem (ISS) and manually remove corrupted, severely noisy, and near-duplicate frames. This process yields approximately 20,000 high-dynamic-range images of planets, asteroids, and natural satellites. Spaceborne capture preserves faint and bright-region detail without ground-atmosphere turbulence. Multiple degradations produce 63,582 training samples and 1,355 source-disjoint test samples.

blocks.en: 4 ASTRA-SR
blocks.zh: 4 ASTRA-SR (英语).

blocks.en: The right portion of Fig. 1 presents the three stages of ASTRA-SR. Intermediate LR estimation suppresses noise while retaining blur information, blur-aware LR restoration recovers spatial and spectral structure, and sequential spatial-amplitude reconstruction produces the final HR image. To guide the placement of frequency processing, we decompose synthesized observations into Fourier magnitude and phase and evaluate recovery when each component is restored toward its clean counterpart. The diagnosis in Fig. 3 shows that magnitude restoration yields larger gains than phase restoration under full and PSF-only degradation, motivating frequency-aware LR processing and amplitude-aware HR refinement [ 6 ] .

blocks.en: The LR restoration pathway fuses multiscale features through cross-scale skip connections. Each block combines SCGN processing with dilated depthwise branches to capture broad degradation patterns and local structure. At full LR resolution, an overlapping Patch-Fourier refiner corrects residual blur in local complex spectra. blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5个实验

blocks.en: Each sample maps a single-channel 256 × 256 256\times 256 degraded LR input to a 512 × 512 512\times 512 HR target. The three-scale SCGN backbone uses widths ( 64 , 96 , 128 ) (64,96,128) with block layouts ( 2 , 1 , 1 ) (2,1,1) for estimation and ( 1 , 1 , 2 ) (1,1,2) for restoration. The local branches use dilation rates { 1 , 4 , 9 } \{1,4,9\} , the global and local residual gains are bounded to ( 0.5 , 1.5 ) (0.5,1.5) , and the amplitude branch operates on pooled 32 × 32 32\times 32 windows with modulation scale 0.10. Training intensities are divided by 2500, giving a normalized Gaussian noise standard deviation of 8 × 10 − 4 8\times 10^{-4} . Predictions are clipped to the physical range and normalized to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . We report macro PSNR, SSIM, and Object-PSNR by removing background. Matched ablations are trained from scratch for 20 epochs under the same optimization settings.

blocks.en: 5.1 Quantitative Evaluation on Synthetic Dataset
blocks.zh: 5.1 合成数据集定量评价

blocks.en: Fig. 3 reports the quantitative Fourier-component restoration analysis used to guide the network design. Under full degradation, magnitude restoration improves PSNR from 31.164 to 34.903 dB, while phase restoration reaches 31.558 dB. The corresponding PSF-only values for the degraded input, magnitude restoration, and phase restoration are 31.195, 35.324, and 31.518 dB. Noise-only degradation benefits similarly from restoring either component.
blocks.zh: 图3报告了用于指导网络设计的Fourier组件修复定量分析。 在完全降解的情况下,相位恢复使PSNR从31.164提高到34.903分贝,而相位恢复则达到31.558分贝. 退化输入、体积恢复和相位恢复的PSF值分别为31.195、35.324和31.518。 dB. (中文(简体) ). 恢复其中任一部分同样有利于噪音的退化。

blocks.en: ASTRA-SR achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, and Object-PSNR among all evaluated methods. Based on the reported table values, it improves over the strongest baseline for each metric by 0.549 dB, 0.003, and 0.487 dB, respectively. The substantial foreground-region PSNR margin further shows that the improvement extends to compact astronomical structures rather than arising only from background smoothing.
blocks.zh: ASTRA-SR在所有评估方法中都取得了最好的PSNR,SSIM和Object-PSNR. 根据报告的表值,它比每个度量的最强基线分别提高了0.549分贝、0.003分贝和0.487分贝。 大量的前地-区域PSNR比值进一步表明,这种改进延伸到了紧凑的天文结构,而不是仅仅产生于背景平滑。

blocks.en: 5.2 Qualitative Evaluation on Real-World Dataset
blocks.zh: 5.2 对现实世界数据集进行定性评价

blocks.en: Fig. 4 includes real Jupiter and lunar observations without reference targets. On Jupiter, ASTRA-SR produces clearer band boundaries and localized atmospheric structures while retaining smooth large-scale intensity variation. On the lunar observation, crater rims and fine surface transitions become more distinct without obvious periodic ringing or isolated artifacts. Although quantitative assessment is unavailable, these results provide qualitative evidence of generalization to real-world data.
blocks.zh: 图4包括没有参考目标的真木星和月球观测. 在木星上,ASTRA-SR产生更清晰的波段界限和局部大气结构,同时保留平滑的大规模强度变化. 在月球观测上,陨坑边缘和细细的地表过渡变得比较分明,没有明显的周期振铃或孤立的文物. 虽然无法进行定量评估,但这些结果提供了向现实世界数据概括的定性证据。

blocks.en: On the paired synthetic cases, ASTRA-SR preserves localized detail with fewer structured residuals near object boundaries.
blocks.zh: 在配对合成物上,ASTRA-SR保留了局部细节,在物体边界附近结构化残基较少.

blocks.en: 5.3 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 5.3 读取研究

blocks.en: Removing the amplitude branch reduces PSNR by 0.413 dB, while removing both HR branches causes a 0.885 dB drop, confirming that spatial and amplitude reconstruction are complementary. Removing intermediate LR supervision or the dilated branches decreases PSNR by 0.11 and 0.11 dB, respectively, which supports the staged separation of noise suppression and blur recovery. The frequency-band adapter, Patch-Fourier refiner, and local residual gain yield smaller but consistent gains, showing that each stage contributes without dominating the complete model.
blocks.zh: 取出振幅分枝使PSNR减少0.413分贝,而取出两个HR分枝则造成0.885分贝的下降,证实空间和振幅重建是互补的. 移除中间LR导管或被分化的分管会使PSNR分别减少0.11和0.11分贝,这支持了噪声抑制和模糊回放的相位分离. 频率波段适配器Patch-Fourier精炼器和局部剩余收益产生较小但一致的增益,显示每个相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: ASTRA-SR combines measurement-driven atmospheric simulation with blur-aware multiscale restoration and serial spatial-amplitude HR reconstruction for blind astronomical super-resolution. Intermediate supervision, Fourier-component analysis, and matched ablations support its staged, amplitude-aware design. Because paired real-world references and astronomical restoration data remain scarce, broader quantitative evaluation across telescope configurations and observing conditions is left for future study.
blocks.zh: ASTRA-SR将测量驱动的大气模拟与模糊-意识多尺度恢复和序列空间-模拟HR重建结合起来,用于盲天文超分辨率. 中间监督,Fourier组件分析,以及匹配的活化剂支持其分阶段的振幅-意识设计。 由于成对的现实世界参考和天文还原数据仍然很少,因此,对望远镜的配置和观测条件进行更广泛的定量评估留待将来研究。
